name: ValidateSpec
description: Validate specifications against project requirements and quality standards. This task checks specification completeness, format compliance, and content quality.
author: Wai Technologies

inputs.name: specPath
inputs.label: Specification Path
inputs.helpMarkDown: Path to the specifications directory. Defaults to $(Build.SourcesDirectory)/specs.

inputs.name: specFile
inputs.label: Specification File
inputs.helpMarkDown: Name of the specification file to validate. Defaults to spec.md.

inputs.name: failOnError
inputs.label: Fail on Error
inputs.helpMarkDown: Fail the build if validation errors are found.

inputs.name: outputPath
inputs.label: Output Path
inputs.helpMarkDown: Path where the validation report will be saved. Defaults to $(Build.SourcesDirectory)/validation-reports.
